content:
The fastest animal is the **peregrine falcon**, which can reach speeds of over 240 mph (386 km/h) when diving to catch prey.

For land animals, the **cheetah** holds the record, capable of running 65-75 mph (104-120 km/h) in short bursts.

In water, the **black marlin** is considered the fastest, swimming at speeds up to 82 mph (132 km/h).
